nodes.label: Orchestrator-Worker Pattern
nodes.rationale: A lead agent can decompose open-ended research into distinct parallel investigations and synthesize their compressed results.

nodes.label: Parallel Context Compression
nodes.rationale: Separate subagent context windows expand reasoning capacity and return only the most important tokens to the lead.

nodes.label: Durable Plan Memory
nodes.rationale: Persisting the research plan protects continuity when a long run exceeds the context window.

nodes.label: Delegation Contract
nodes.rationale: Each subtask needs an objective, output format, tool and source guidance, and explicit boundaries to prevent gaps and duplication.

nodes.label: Outcome-Based Agent Evaluation
nodes.rationale: Non-deterministic agents may follow different valid paths, so evaluation should emphasize achieved outcomes and reasonable process rather than a single prescribed trace.

nodes.label: Synchronous Join Bottleneck
nodes.rationale: Waiting for a whole subagent batch simplifies coordination but lets one slow worker block information flow and prevents live steering.

nodes.label: Checkpoint and Retry Recovery
nodes.rationale: Stateful errors compound and full restarts are expensive, so deterministic retries and regular checkpoints enable resumption.

nodes.label: Filesystem Artifact Handoff
nodes.rationale: Persisted artifacts preserve specialist output fidelity and reduce token overhead from relaying large outputs through the coordinator.

nodes.label: Automated Feedback Cycle
nodes.rationale: Specialized agents repeatedly generate, evaluate, and refine hypotheses so output quality and novelty can improve.

nodes.label: Test-Time Compute Scaling
nodes.rationale: Additional iterative reasoning, evolution, and evaluation are used to improve scientific proposals at inference time.

nodes.label: Self-Play Scientific Debate
nodes.rationale: Adversarial scientific debate supplies critique and novelty pressure during hypothesis generation.

nodes.label: Ranking Tournaments
nodes.rationale: Pairwise competition compares hypotheses and supplies Elo-based feedback for selection.

nodes.label: Expert-in-the-Loop Validation
nodes.rationale: Human expertise and laboratory or computational experiments are required to test practical utility beyond self-evaluation.

nodes.label: Provider-Neutral CLI Adapters
nodes.rationale: Provider wire formats and manifests vary, so one adapter per CLI should normalize them behind a stable internal contract.

nodes.label: Canonical Append-Only Event Stream
nodes.rationale: Persisted normalized events provide replayable lifecycle state, provenance, and forward-compatible provider extensions.

nodes.label: Bounded Fan-Out
nodes.rationale: Parallelism should be limited to distinct valuable work because multi-agent token cost can greatly exceed chat.

nodes.label: Dependency-Aware Scheduling
nodes.rationale: Only independent branches should run concurrently; workers sharing mutable state require isolation or serialization.

nodes.label: Checkpoint Before Handoff
nodes.rationale: Plans, terminal branch results, and approval state must be committed before fan-out, synthesis, or waiting.

nodes.label: Separate Synthesis Stage
nodes.rationale: Immutable adviser artifacts should remain available while synthesis consumes references and compact summaries.

nodes.label: Final-Result Schema Validation
nodes.rationale: Every provider result needs local validation against Council's own schema, with one bounded repair or fail-closed outcome.

nodes.label: Shared Budget Ledger
nodes.rationale: Budget must be reserved before branch launch and reconciled from usage so concurrent branches cannot spend the same allowance.

nodes.label: Explicit Approval Boundary
nodes.rationale: External writes, publication, destructive operations, credential expansion, and budget expansion require durable human authorization.

nodes.label: Cancellation Ladder
nodes.rationale: Cancellation stops new scheduling, requests graceful provider termination, then terminates the process tree while preserving terminal-state immutability.

nodes.label: Model-Family Diversity
nodes.rationale: Materially different model families create more independent hypotheses than role-play or repeated samples from one backbone.

nodes.label: Round-Zero Aggregate Baseline
nodes.rationale: Independent voting explains much of the apparent benefit of debate and must be recorded before peer influence.

nodes.label: Bounded Selective Deliberation
nodes.rationale: Debate should continue only for material disagreement or unresolved evidence and normally stop after no more than two critique rounds.

nodes.label: Blinded Bias-Checked Adjudication
nodes.rationale: Authorship must be hidden and pairwise order reversed because judges exhibit position, verbosity, self, and provider affinity biases.

nodes.label: Rank-Then-Synthesize
nodes.rationale: Validate and rank candidates before fusing only the top admissible set, while retaining claim attribution and dissent.

nodes.label: Calibrated Confidence Weighting
nodes.rationale: Confidence collected before peer exposure should be historically calibrated and used only as a bounded secondary weight.

nodes.label: Independent Failure-Domain Quorum
nodes.rationale: Quorum counts materially independent model families rather than raw agent processes; an evidence-backed minority can block automatic closure.

nodes.label: Adaptive Stop and Audit
nodes.rationale: Stop on verified resolution, stable private ballots without new evidence, or the round cap, and log the factors needed to audit the decision.

nodes.label: Immutable Task Contract
nodes.rationale: The trusted user request must define the plan and capability set before untrusted evidence is exposed to models.

nodes.label: Capability Broker
nodes.rationale: Short-lived capabilities bound to a run, worker, operation, resource, and destination create an enforceable authorization boundary outside the model.

nodes.label: Evidence Quarantine
nodes.rationale: Raw fetched bytes stay outside model context while models receive bounded sanitized extracts labeled as untrusted.

nodes.label: Worker Isolation
nodes.rationale: Each worker receives an ephemeral environment, read-only evidence, and no ambient credentials or access to another worker's private state.

nodes.label: Network Egress Broker
nodes.rationale: A policy broker validates scheme, destination, DNS results, redirects, and private or metadata ranges before any request.

nodes.label: Secret Firewall
nodes.rationale: Prompts, tool arguments, network requests, artifacts, OCR, logs, and errors must be scanned and plaintext credentials must not persist.

nodes.label: Claim-to-Evidence Citations
nodes.rationale: Each material claim must map to exact artifact identifiers and spans, pages, or regions whose support is checked.

nodes.label: Typed Provenance Status
nodes.rationale: Validation must preserve valid, invalid, untrusted, unknown, and inaccessible states with reason codes rather than a trusted Boolean.

nodes.label: Fail-Closed Commitment Boundary
nodes.rationale: Unknown provenance, destination, capability, citation support, or secret status must stop a side effect while safe quarantined research may continue.

nodes.label: Recursive Lineage Validation
nodes.rationale: C2PA validation applies through ingredient lineage rather than only to the active manifest.

nodes.label: Separate Provenance Dimensions
nodes.rationale: Content binding, signer trust, action history, and factual assessment are distinct dimensions and must not collapse into one trust flag.

nodes.label: Pixel Capture Verification
nodes.rationale: A successful renderer exit does not prove useful capture; inspecting rendered pixels detected a blank PDF viewer.

nodes.label: Multi-Agent Research System
nodes.rationale: Research paths are unpredictable, dynamic, and path-dependent, so multiple agents can explore breadth-first in parallel and compress findings into a final answer.

nodes.label: Orchestrator-Worker Pattern
nodes.rationale: A lead agent coordinates the process and delegates specialized, parallel work to subagents.

nodes.label: Parallel Exploration
nodes.rationale: Independent subagents can pursue different aspects of an open-ended query at the same time, reducing path dependency and enabling thorough investigation.

nodes.label: Search Compression
nodes.rationale: Subagents distill large search spaces into the most important tokens for the lead agent, acting as parallel context filters.

nodes.label: Context Window Distribution
nodes.rationale: Separate agents provide separate context windows, allowing the system to process more information than one agent can hold.

nodes.label: Token Usage Scaling
nodes.rationale: Multi-agent architectures scale token usage for tasks that exceed the limits of a single agent; token usage explained most observed performance variance in the cited evaluation.

nodes.label: Claude Sonnet 4
nodes.rationale: The article reports that upgrading to Claude Sonnet 4 produced a larger performance gain than doubling the token budget on Claude Sonnet 3.7.

nodes.label: High Token Cost Trade-off
nodes.rationale: The architecture uses about four times more tokens than chat interactions and about fifteen times more tokens for multi-agent systems, so it is appropriate when the task value justifies the added cost.

nodes.label: Coordination and Reliability Challenges
nodes.rationale: Multiple agents introduce coordination, evaluation, and reliability problems, especially when they must share context or when tasks have many interdependencies.

nodes.norm_label: figure 4: reconcile achieves better and faster consensus

nodes.label: ReConcile
nodes.rationale: ReConcile uses multiple rounds of discussion among diverse LLM agents so that explanations and confidence estimates can correctively convince other agents and improve reasoning.

nodes.label: Positive Consensus-Accuracy Correlation
nodes.rationale: For samples that enter discussion, the plotted accuracy rises as a greater fraction reaches consensus.

nodes.label: Diverse LLM Agents
nodes.rationale: Model diversity initially lowers agreement because agents hold different opinions, but it supplies alternate solutions that support stronger later discussion.

nodes.label: External Feedback
nodes.rationale: Access to feedback from diverse models provides alternative solutions and helps improve discussion and reasoning accuracy.

nodes.label: API Call Cost
nodes.rationale: Additional discussion rounds increase API calls, so reaching consensus sooner while preserving accuracy is more efficient.
